pages.title: A machine will not run
pages.text: $(li)Check redstone mode.$(li)Supply both flux types.$(li)Put matching tanks above generators.$(li)Use connectors at machines.$(li)Check ingredients and output space.$(br2)The manual Constructor needs ingredients in your inventory and no cable power.

pages.title: Missing recipes or effects
pages.text: A Constructor needs a populated blueprint in directly adjacent Blueprint Storage. Hover over a crossed-out result for missing ingredients.$(br2)Equipment needs an installed, enabled module, both dusts, and room in that piece’s power budget.$(br2)For item transfers, check both filters, a closed marker border connected to the controller, and nodes within the field’s height.
